title: Evidence Sprint: Manager Rehearsal Playbook
content:
Purpose:
Quick, scannable playbook for the next 2 weeks: gather and practise presenting evidence to my manager ahead of calibration + promotion conversation. Lightweight; meant for rehearsals, not polished narrative.

Context:
- Role: Senior People Ops Partner (product/eng-facing)
- Timebox: 2 week evidence sprint (Feb 10 -> Feb 24) with manager rehearsal on Feb 26
- Stake: preparing promotion packet + ask for 2026 Q2 stretch lead on org design pilot
- Audience: direct manager (Leads: Leah), calibration committee

TL;DR elevator pitches (2 variants):
1) Short (30s): "In the last 12 months I drove three cross-functional pilots that reduced onboarding time by 22% and removed 18 blocker tickets for new hires; I partnered closely with Platform and DevEx to bake those changes into the onboarding template and runbook. I want to move into a role where I own larger org-design pilots and mentor 2 ICs into manager-readiness this year."
2) Narrative (90s): "We had repeated friction with first-90-day ramp for new engineers — unclear infra defaults, lots of context gap tickets. I designed a fast feedback loop: 1) diagnostic survey for new hires (N=84), 2) paired onboarding sessions with platform SMEs (6 sessions), and 3) a runbook + playbook that automated the most common fixes. Results: ramp time (measured by first PR-to-merge) improved 22% median, onboarding tickets dropped from 47/month to 29/month, and hiring managers reported higher confidence (pulse +0.35). I led the stakeholders, iterated the prompts, and shipped the runbook to GH so it’s maintained by Platform. That’s the scale of cross-team change I’m asking to run more broadly as a promotion ask."

Top 3 wins (data-backed, one-line each):
- Onboarding runbook shipped + maintained in hr-playbooks repo; first-PR-to-merge median down 22% (baseline Jan 2025 -> Jan 2026).
- Pilot: peer buddy program (pilot cohort N=40) increased new-hire retention at 6 months from 86% -> 92% (small n, but directionally strong).
- Process automation: triage template cut platform tickets by 18/month; saved ~12 engineering hours/month in ops triage.

Signals of leadership (evidence snippets to rehearse):
- Stakeholder influence: Extract from Slack thread (Platform #infra-onboard) where Director of Platform committed to allocating 0.2 FTE for runbook automation (TIMESTAMP: 2025-11-08).
- Data fluency: dashboard screenshot (CONFLUENCE-4321) showing PR->merge distributions before/after pilot; can cite median change, 90th percentile, and sample size.
- Coaching impact: three direct reports (names redacted in this doc) completed manager-readiness plan; two promoted to L4 in the last cycle.

STAR examples (3 concise stories to rehearse):
1) Situation: repeat onboarding blockers for new SREs.
   Task: reduce time-to-first-meaningful-PR and reduce triage noise.
   Action: authored a 6-step diagnostic, set up paired sessions, shipped runbook + triage template in GH.
   Result: 22% median improvement; triage tickets down 18/month.
2) Situation: low manager confidence in early rotations.
   Task: create a repeatable buddy+check-in cadence.
   Action: designed 8-week buddy program, trained buddies with a 1-pager, measured outcomes.
   Result: retention bump to 92% at 6 months for pilot cohort; positive manager survey nps +0.4.
3) Situation: org-wide role clarity gaps causing duplicated work.
   Task: propose a lightweight RACI for three shared services teams.
   Action: convened a cross-functional working group, produced RACI and 1-page decision rules, rolled out in one team as experiment.
   Result: eliminated 6 duplicated tickets in 8 weeks; working group committed to scale.

Hard feedback / risk areas (be candid):
- Scope creep: I often take on operational cleanup that delays strategic follow-through.
- Measurement rigor: sample sizes for some pilots are small; need to run with larger cohorts or more robust A/B.
- Delegation: tendency to run deep in execution vs. enable a PM or counterpart to own next steps.

Manager rehearsal: likely questions + suggested concise answers
Q: "Why promotion now?"
A: "I’ve demonstrated repeatable impact across pilots, raised org-level tooling, and mentored peers into higher levels. The promotion enables me to run larger org-design pilots and free up headspace to scale these processes across more teams."

Q: "How will you measure success in the promoted role?"
A: "Clear KPIs: 1) reduce mean time-to-productivity by X% across 2 teams in 6 months; 2) transition two ICs to manager-readiness (validated by manager feedback and readiness rubric); 3) reduce cross-team duplication measured via ticket dedupe by 30% for piloted scopes."

Q: "If committee pushes back on scale or rigor, what’s your fallback?"
A: "Propose a time-bound senior IC+pilot owner experiment: 3-month charter with pre-registered metrics, quick check-ins, and a gate for expansion—low risk, evidence-first approach."

Concrete asks to land in the conversation
- Promotion ask: move to Staff People Ops (or equivalent) title effective Q2; primary justification: repeatable cross-functional impact + mentoring throughput.
- Resourcing ask: 0.4 FTE dedicated engineering partner for runbook automation for 6 months.
- Growth ask: sponsorship for a 3-day org design workshop with external facilitator (budget ~ $6k).

Evidence index (one-line pointers to artifacts to attach to packet)
- Onboarding dashboard: CONFLUENCE-4321 (PR->merge distributions, cohort N=84).
- Pilot write-up + slides: https://drive/redwood/hr/onboarding/pilot-q4-2025 (attach in packet).
- GH runbook and templates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hr-playbooks/tree/main/onboarding-runbook (commits + author logged).
- Slack commitment excerpt: CONVERSATION ID: slack-thread/PLATFORM/2025-11-08 (captures Director commit).

Rehearsal checklist (pre-meeting):
- [ ] Attach dashboards and one-pager to calendar invite.
- [ ] Run 3x vocal rehearsals of TL;DR pitch (30s, 90s, 2-min).
- [ ] Practice answers to 5 likely hard questions (cost, scale, delegation, metrics, fallback).
- [ ] Share prep packet with manager 48 hours ahead.
- [ ] Pick 2 real-time examples to walk through (link artifacts).

Next actions (this sprint):
1) Pull final numbers from analytics dashboard (Ethan) — due Feb 14.
2) Draft 1-pager for promotion packet (me) — due Feb 18.
3) Confirm manager rehearsal slot (Nina) — due Feb 20.
4) Attach GH links + Slack excerpts to packet — due Feb 22.

Loose notes / rehearsal lines to memorize:
- "I run evidence-first pilots that reduce cognitive load for teams and free engineering time to ship product features."
- "I ask for the title because it unlocks authority to convene leaders and to run org-level experiments with credibility."
- "If scale is a concern, I propose a 90-day charter with pre-registered metrics and a clear go/no-go gate."

Open questions to resolve before rehearsal:
- Can we get a 6-month rolling view for PR->merge (to smooth seasonality)? (ask Analytics)
- Is there a precedent for 0.2->0.4 FTE engineering resourcing in pilot funding? (ask Leah)
- How does compensation ladder map to Staff People Ops here? Need comp band lookup. (Compensation team)

Final note (meta):
This doc is intentionally messy — use it as a rehearsal tool. After the rehearsal, I will extract the best lines into a succinct 1-pager and attach dashboards. Save versioned copies (v1, v2) in the hr/promo folder.

-- Aisha
